scenario: Build a hand-mobility progress report for two patients from their chart photos.
did: Read each chart, count functional vs limited areas at both time points, and compute recovery %.
why: The checks that are present all verify, but the rubric only covers one of the two patients. The prompt asks for the Functional/Limited counts at both times and the recovery % for both Emily and Paul — there are checks for Emily (C4 starting counts, C5 one-year counts, C6 recovery %), but nothing checks Paul's Map C and Map D counts or his recovery %, and no test covers them either.
fix: Add three checks for Paul mirroring C4/C5/C6 — his Map C (starting) Functional/Limited counts, his Map D (one-year) counts, and his recovery %.
agree: Yes — both flag it as failing.

scenario: Turn a kid's bean-plant journal and photos into a corrected growth dataset and report.

agree: Yes — both agree it holds up.
